market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI is currently ~$102 (May 1, 2026), having retreated ~3% from a recent high near $111 amid Strait of Hormuz tensions. EIA forecasts Brent peaking ~$115 in Q2 2026, putting WTI near $108-112. With ~29 days left and elevated volatility, a single 1-minute candle hitting $110 is plausible but not certain.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether US-Iran de-escalation trims the geopolitical premium below $110.
